## Vue d'ensemble

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Encadrements par année universitaire et par type"
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("data/encadrements.csv")
agg = df.groupby(["annee_universitaire", "type"]).size().reset_index(name="count")
fig = px.bar(
    agg, x="annee_universitaire", y="count", color="type",
    labels={"count": "Nombre d'encadrements", "annee_universitaire": "Année universitaire"},
    color_discrete_sequence=["#C8102E", "#4A4A4A", "#0277BD", "#2E7D32", "#F57C00", "#6A1B9A"],
)
fig.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white", height=420, barmode="stack",
    margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.2),
)
fig.show()
```

## Tableau interactif complet

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True)

df = pd.read_csv("data/encadrements.csv")
df = df.sort_values(["annee", "type"], ascending=[False, True])
show(df, lengthMenu=[10, 25, 50], classes="display compact")
```
